close_reason: Working as designed: SpaceStore manages 3 type counters (Space, SpaceInvite, SpaceBan), requiring the type_name parameter. Other stores each manage exactly one type. The divergence reflects a genuine structural difference, not inconsistency.
description:
The private emit() helper has a different signature in SpaceStore vs the three other stores:

- ChatStore::emit(&self, new_state: String)      — crates/kith-store/src/chat.rs line 178
- ContactStore::emit(&self, new_state: String)   — crates/kith-store/src/contact.rs line 23
- MessageStore::emit(&self, new_state: String)   — crates/kith-store/src/message.rs line 646
- SpaceStore::emit(&self, type_name: &str, new_state: String)  — crates/kith-store/src/space.rs line 173

SpaceStore manages multiple state counters (Space, SpaceInvite, SpaceBan) which is why it needs the type_name parameter. However, this makes SpaceStore::emit diverge from the pattern established by all other stores, making it harder to extract a common trait or helper.

Fix: either add a type_name parameter to all stores (and hardcode it in each, as SpaceStore already requires it at call sites), or refactor SpaceStore to use separate per-type emit helpers matching the other stores' single-type pattern.
title: SpaceStore::emit takes (type_name, new_state) but other stores take only (new_state)
